description: A single thermodynamic line plot (no caption supplied) built from six curves that together show logK_AlN (solid lines) and logQ_AlN (dashed lines) as functions of the solid fraction z_s. The x-axis is labelled z_s and runs 0.0–1.0 with ticks every 0.2; the y-axis is labelled "logK_AlN & logQ_AlN" and runs -3.0 to -1.0 with ticks every 0.5. A boxed legend maps line styles to heats: solid black = logK (1#), dashed black = logQ (1#), solid blue = logK (2#), dashed blue = logQ (2#), solid red = logK (3#), dashed red = logQ (3#). All three solid logK curves decrease monotonically with z_s, the red 3# curve staying highest and then falling steeply after z_s ≈ 0.8; all three dashed logQ curves rise monotonically and converge on -1.0 at z_s = 1.0, while the solid logK curves converge near -3.0 at z_s = 1.0. Three filled circular markers are labelled with arrows — "0.51 (3#)" on the red pair, "0.22 (2#)" on the blue pair and "0.46 (1#)" on the black pair — each sitting where a solid logK curve meets its dashed logQ partner. The figure thus presents the logK = logQ thermodynamic intersection condition for AlN in the three heats as a function of solid fraction; no numeric values are printed other than the three annotated z_s labels.

observations.observation: The x-axis is labelled z_s and spans 0.0 to 1.0 with gridline ticks every 0.2.
The y-axis is labelled "logK_AlN & logQ_AlN" and spans -3.0 to -1.0 with ticks every 0.5.
The legend lists six entries: logK (1#) solid black, logQ (1#) dashed black, logK (2#) solid blue, logQ (2#) dashed blue, logK (3#) solid red, logQ (3#) dashed red.
Three solid logK curves decrease monotonically with z_s, whereas the three dashed logQ curves increase monotonically; solid and dashed curves of the same colour cross.
Three filled circular markers with leader arrows are annotated "0.51 (3#)", "0.22 (2#)" and "0.46 (1#)", each placed where a solid logK curve meets its dashed logQ partner.
The red 3# solid logK curve remains the highest of the three solid curves until roughly z_s = 0.8 and then drops steeply toward the bottom of the axis.
All three dashed logQ curves converge at the top-right corner near logK/logQ = -1.0 at z_s = 1.0, while all three solid logK curves converge near -3.0 at z_s = 1.0.
The blue 2# curves meet at the smallest annotated z_s (0.22), the black 1# pair at 0.46 and the red 3# pair at 0.51.

subfigures.description: One linear-linear plot of logK_AlN (three solid curves) and logQ_AlN (three dashed curves) versus z_s from 0.0 to 1.0, y from -3.0 to -1.0; black/blue/red denote heats 1#/2#/3#; three annotated filled dots mark the logK-logQ meetings at z_s = 0.51 (3#), 0.22 (2#) and 0.46 (1#).
